notes.title: Bundle Now Available: East Trade Tycoon + Skyline Urban Story
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]My new game [b]Skyline Urban Story[/b] is now live on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]Don’t be fooled by its minimalist look—behind the charming visuals lies a deep city-management sim packed with strategic depth.For a full rundown, hop over to the store page:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3185000/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]As a thank-you to longtime [b]East Trade Tycoon[/b] players, I’ve also put together a bundle with an extra 10 % discount:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54470/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]The game was created entirely by me, so some rough edges are inevitable. If you run into any issues or bugs, please drop me a message on social media or send me an email instead of leaving a negative review right away—I read every bit of feedback and push out fixes as quickly as I can.[/p][p]I hope you have a great time playing! If you enjoy the game, leaving a review or recommending it to friends would mean the world to me.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Will East Trade Tycoon still get updates?[/b][/h3][p]I’d love to keep updating it, but as my first Unity cross-platform project the underlying code isn’t the cleanest, so every patch is a bit of a battle and risks introducing new bugs. I still tinker with it when I can, and I’ll let everyone know if a significant update is on the way.[/p]

notes.title: V2.0.19 Update
notes.notes:
1. Optimized hotkey settings: Spacebar now toggles game start/pause even in non-world map interfaces, + - key adjusts speed, and Esc returns to the previous level. To avoid conflicts with the spacebar, the shortcut for skipping dialogues and reminders has been changed to only the Enter key.  You can view the specific hotkeys in the game settings.（Custom hotkeys will be available in the future.）
2. Added an option in the game settings to toggle repetitive strategy reminders.
3. Optimized the code logic for moving between cities, reducing unexpected pauses.
4. Fixed a bug where game time continued during a robbers encounter.
5. Added a setting to prevent characters with a marriage contract from being expelled or retired, to avoid data conflicts.

notes.title: Announcement about the upcoming end of free access for East Trade Tycoon
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is PandaUpStudio, the developer of "East Trade Tycoon: Inheritance". After being released for free for a while, the game has attracted a large number of players' attention and love. Thank you very much to all the players who have played this game!

For the healthy development of the studio, I will apply to Steam customer service to change the game from free to paid in 7 days (the application may take several working days), mainly to support the subsequent development and updates of the game. All players who have already added this game to their libraries will not be affected in any way and can continue to play the game normally as well as receive normal update support for the game itself.

If you have any comments or suggestions about the game, you are also welcomed to leave a comment below.

notes.title: V2.0.18 Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug that sometimes when there is no betrothal gift being sent, but clicking on the matchmaker always shows that the betrothal gift is being sent.
2. Fixed the problem of incorrect descriptions of some caravan items when choosing the birthplace.
3.Fixed the bug that some city operations can still be performed in city browsing mode.
4.Fixed the bug that the letter delivery task can refresh the local city task.

notes.title: V2.0.17 update
notes.notes:
Mainly fix the freeze problem caused by the V2.0.16 update.

V2.0.16 update
1. Added: After completing a strategy, you can choose whether to repeat the same strategy, reducing repetitive operations.
2. Fixed a bug where, in certain situations (e.g., after viewing city information and closing the window), the city could not be clicked or moved.
3. Optimized a bug where the game would pause irregularly after a game popup or character dialogue.
4. Fixed several bugs that could cause the game to crash when loading a saved game.

notes.title: V2.0.16 Update
notes.notes:
1. Added: After completing a strategy, you can choose whether to repeat the same strategy, reducing repetitive operations.
2. Fixed a bug where, in certain situations (e.g., after viewing city information and closing the window), the city could not be clicked or moved.
3. Optimized a bug where the game would pause irregularly after a game popup or character dialogue.
4. Fixed several bugs that could cause the game to crash when loading a saved game.

notes.title: V2.0.13 Update
notes.notes:
1. Attempted to fix the bug where the game screen would infinitely shift as soon as the game is opened. (If players still encounter this problem, please give me feedback again.)
2. Optimized the scrolling speed of all scrolling windows.
3. Goods obtained by defeating robbers will not cause the caravan to be overloaded. Excess goods will be automatically sold on the spot and converted into money.
4. Fixed the bug where when loading a save, if the character is in an edge city (such as Huanglong), they will be forcibly refreshed to the base.
5. For automatic saves, added options to save once every three months and once every six months.
6. Fixed the problem of the reversed trigger sequence of achievements regarding firm control quotas.

notes.title: V2.0.12 Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed a bug where the game would crash repeatedly when loading a save file after a crash in certain situations.
2. Optimized the achievement detection logic to speed up achievement triggers.

notes.title: V2.0.11 Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue preventing the Mac version from being playable in the Steam store.
2. Resolved the overflow issue when transferring ownership if assets exceed 2.1 billion, which only displayed as 2.1 billion.
3. Added a slider to the caravan item interface to indicate that items can be scrolled for viewing.
4. Introduced a random name generator for creating business names on Steam Deck, allowing players to continue the game.
5. Fixed incorrect display and calculation of copper coin costs when resting for a specified number of days at the inn.
6. Resolved crashes that could occur in certain situations when merging items.
7. Fixed the issue where newly purchased vehicles could be priced higher than the purchase price in some cases.
